description: Marketplace for Claude Code plugins published from github.com/wcy/ai-plugins

plugins.name: metacoder
plugins.description: Spec-to-ship workflow that keeps codebases coherent: write specs (mspec), reverse-engineer/reconcile specs from code (mreverse), plan implementations (mplan), verify conformance (mverify), execute plans as worktree-isolated waves (mexecute), and run the whole loop autonomously (mquick)
